title: Simple derivations and isotropy on Danielewski-type algebras
summary: Let $\K$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. We study isotropy groups of simple derivations on Danielewski-type algebras \[ A_{c,q}=\K[x,y,z]/(c(x)z-q(x,y)). \] More precisely, motivated by the recent result of Mendes and Pan for simple derivations of $\K[x,y]$ (\cite[Theorem 1]{MP}), we ask whether every simple derivation $D$ of $A_{c,q}$ has trivial isotropy group.
